comment: Pull requests GitHub reports as MERGED whose merge commit is not reachable
from `main`, and which tools/check_merged_prs_landed.py therefore reports
as KNOWN rather than as a finding. Issue #1342.
Every entry was merged into a base branch other than `main`. Two things
produce that: a base branch that had already been squash-merged, which
strands the work; and a stacked PR whose parent branch was later squashed
to main, which carries the work under a different commit. Ancestry cannot
tell those apart, so each entry records a VERDICT and a WITNESS, and
tools/landing_witness.py re-measures the witness on every run (issue
#1434): `added` must equal the merge's own added set. A CARRIED entry
names `carried_at`, the commit that brought the work in, which must be
an ancestor of the tree under test; `identical` paths must be
byte-identical to the merge's copy AT THAT COMMIT, and `drifted` paths
(carried already modified) name the merge's own tests that pin them,
which must collect and pass. Later edits cost nothing: carrying is a
historical fact. `absent` paths (STRANDED) must be absent now. A REWORKED
entry has no file witness and is reported as UNCHECKED, not as verified.
The `note` is prose; its first verdict word must match `verdict`, and every
path it names that the merge touched must be in the witness.
This ratchet SHRINKS ONLY. An entry whose merge commit becomes reachable
from main has been merged properly after all, and the checker FAILS until
the entry is deleted. An entry may never be added to turn a red check
green: a new stranding is a defect to fix.

1296.note: merged into agent/1196-ui-transaction-phases, already squashed to main. CARRIED by PR #1325 (commit e1bb8131), measured rather than reported. The earlier note said there was no cheap witness because the merge added no files. That was wrong about the method, not about the facts: it added none, but it MODIFIED three, src/revl/erase_report.py, docs/erase-report.md and tests/test_erase_report.py, and all three are BYTE-IDENTICAL to this merge's copies at e1bb8131, including the 80 lines of tests it added to the last. A modified file is a witness, so 'no files added' is not by itself a reason to stop looking.

1308.note: merged into agent/81-stream-tiers. REWORKED: `document_holds_stream`, added by this merge to selfhost/emit_go.rvl, is still absent from main and is deliberately not restored. Reading `subscribe` / `stream-iter` there would move those discriminants out of the go tier's `unported` baseline in tests/fixtures/selfhost_blind_spots.json on the strength of a refusal predicate. Main reaches the same outcome by the cheaper route issue #1321 took: the marker's suppression now also requires that no component be OBSERVABLE, and `component_is_observable` reads the LENGTH of a component's `body`, so a stream component is named without any stream spelling being read. Measured on 3f74900fb with this merge's two single-arm cases re-authored against that rule: a source-only `Stream.source()` acquisition and a subscription with no loop are both named, one marker per components entry, each holding the reference to emitting `stc-go` where the port emits its marker. Those two cases are on main in tests/test_selfhost_emit_go.py.

1309.note: merged into agent/1192-shadow-routing. CARRIED: src/revl/shadow_runtime.py and tests/test_shadow_runtime_518.py, both added by this merge, reached main in commit ce53dbe3 (PR #1432). That commit squashes a `git cherry-pick -x` of this merge (the provenance line names e419e7a4) together with two fixes the rebase onto main needed, so neither file is the merge's copy there: shadow_runtime.py reads a component's provide methods through `mcp.schema.provided_methods` rather than walking them itself (the vocabulary-mirror gate refused the second copy), and the test module's fixture now declares its model roles' reach, which item 519's G-MODEL-PLACE rule requires. src/revl/shadow_routing.py and docs/design/558-shadow-scheduling.md came across in the same pick unchanged. backends/python/runtime.py did not: the one conflict was in `revl_reset_run_trace_state`, where item 517's sealer reset and item 518's shadow reset were added to the same tail and both are kept. The three drifted paths are pinned by the 27 tests this merge wrote in tests/test_shadow_runtime_518.py, named one by one, because a whole-file pin is only accepted for a test file that is still the merge's copy.
